goal: Allow one approved operator to start and stop the BabySteps AWS performance observation pipeline through a Cloudflare Access independent-MFA control plane.
nonGoals: Device posture as an authorization factor
Arbitrary repository, workflow, AWS command, duration, region, or stack inputs
A second VPC, NAT gateway, database, OIDC provider, or shared foundation
Publishing credentials, raw identity claims, cookies, tokens, or private telemetry
networkScope: AWS account 782086108248 in us-east-1 through repository-scoped OIDC roles
Fixed HTTPS callback to the Baby2B performance-control Worker
acceptanceCriteria: Only the fixed start, stop, and scheduled-expiry operations are accepted
The live stack reuses the verified shared VPC, NAT, RDS, artifact bucket, and GitHub OIDC provider
At most one live project stack exists and its TTL is fixed at 45 minutes
Estimated incremental cost is capped at USD 0.20 before deployment
Stop and expiry perform final aggregation, exact schema deletion, exact stack deletion, and zero-residue verification
Status callbacks are authenticated and contain no AWS or GitHub credentials
Failures remain retryable and never claim successful cleanup without readback
Evidence records architecture, sequence, cost, limitations, tests, and sanitized production proof
